description: This file defines the 'InAccessibleEntityId' class, which is a validation rule for checking entity access permissions within the OrangeHRM system. It uses traits for ORM entity management and user role management, and includes logic to validate whether a given entity ID is accessible based on roles and permissions.

classes.name: InAccessibleEntityId
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if an entity ID is accessible based on user roles and permissions within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validation rule with the entity name and optional access options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Executes the validation to determine if the entity ID provided is accessible, possibly throwing an exception or returning false based on options.
